thread:
pagerbot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on infer-gateway-prod (us-west-2). 5xx rate jumped from ~15% to ~62% in 2m. Paging oncall.

oncall-eli: joining the channel, looking at dashboards now.
sara-eng: I’m seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner v2.3.4 on node gpu-23, coredumps appearing.
luis-ml: correlating with the latest quantized kernel build we rolled yesterday. stacktrace points at attention_qkv_kernel.

mike-sre: can we immediate-reroute traffic to fallback model variant? Also consider disabling quant kernels as a stopgap.

oncall-eli: initiating mitigation plan: 1) reroute portion of traffic to fallback smaller model 2) scale down batch_size via feature flag 3) drain affected node. Doing step 1 now.
sara-eng: logs snippet from gpu-23: ```
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] segfault at 0x7fabbccd
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] backtrace: attention_qkv_kernel+0x1f3
[2026-03-17T15:04:13Z] killed process 45231 (model-runner)
```

luis-ml: same on my end. Repro rate high when batch_size >= 4 and using 8-bit quant kernels. Suggest immediate override to batch_size=1.

infra-bot: starting drain of node gpu-23, marking unschedulable. ETA 40s.
mike-sre: rolling 30% of gateway traffic to fallback-policy alpha-fallback (smaller model, single-threaded runner).
oncall-eli: applying batch_size override flag to prod-route: `rbp.features.infer.batch_override=1` 

sara-eng: also preparing a hotpatch to disable quantized attention kernels (will flip to fp16 path). Compiling patch now.

customer-success: we have early reports of timeouts from 3 customers (acme-inc, beta-app, scale-ai-proto). Opening customer impact doc. Will prepare an outbound once we know scope.
luis-ml: mitigation checks: reduce batch_size && disable quant kernels => expected memory drop ~20-30%, reduces KV cache pressure.

mike-sre: metrics update: 5xx spiked to 62% at 15:04; after 30% reroute + batch_override, overall 5xx -> 28% in 3m. Still high but trending down.
oncall-eli: pushing additional 40% to fallback (total 70% rerouted) while we stabilize.

infra-bot: drain complete on gpu-23. Evicted 3 pods, recreated elsewhere.
sara-eng: hotpatch deployed to container image: disabled quant-attention path, fallback to fp16 kernel. Patch id: hp-2026-0317-01. Rolling canary to 10% of runners.
luis-ml: logs after hotpatch show no segfaults on canary. Good sign.

mike-sre: gradual traffic shift back: reducing reroute to 40% now. Error rate across prod: 12% and still falling.
oncall-eli: removing batch_override for routes we trust, keeping batch_size=1 on the heavy tenants until tomorrow.

pagerbot: METRICS: 5xx rate: peak 62% -> 12% over 12m after combined mitigations. CPU/GPU and memory profiles returning to baseline.

sara-eng: collecting cores + /proc/maps + dmesg from gpu-23 and attaching to incident trace for RCA.
luis-ml: saving model-runner logs and nvcc kernel warnings: `/var/log/model-runner/gpu-23/*.log` and `kv-cache` snapshot.

customer-success: drafting message for affected tenants with ETA for detailed RCA. Will coordinate with PM/legal for language.
oncall-eli: post-incident actions: 1) full RCA with kernel regression check 2) revert or pin quant-kernel build across fleet 3) add smoke test for quant attention under heavy batching 4) update runbook to reduce default batch_size for quant builds.
mike-sre: scheduling a short postmortem sync at 18:00 UTC. Please bring traces and core dumps.

pagerbot: Incident marked "mitigated" at 4267000120. 

oncall-eli: thanks everyone — keeping this channel open for follow-ups. Will file incident ticket and link artifacts. 

sara-eng: ack. saving artifacts to the incident folder and starting RCA draft.

customer-success: once RCA ready send me a preview for customer-facing summary.

mike-sre: thumbs up. closing live mitigation loop but leaving monitoring on for next 24h. :white_check_mark:
